name_reason: Name follows fd2_<descriptor> game-function convention, accurately reflects logic (recalculates a battle runtime char's four derived combat stats AP/DP/DX_current/evade), and carries no Ghidra address residue. Sibling helpers in battle.c use the same fd2_<verb>_<descriptor> form (fd2_recompute_runtime_char_total_stats twin, fd2_check_can_counter_attack).
purpose: Recalculate a battle runtime character's four derived combat stats (AP/DP/DX_current/evade) after any stat-affecting event (item use, equip/unequip, status-timer expiry, XP level-up, promotion, shop buy/sell/give, chapter init, battle init).
logic_summary: rc = data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr. Seeds ap_total/dp_total from combat_aux_block +0x10/+0x12 (s16 base AP/DP) and dx_total from ai_target_and_dx_block +1 (s16 base DX). If status_flags_block[3] (dx_buff, 'agility' magic) set, dx_total += 0xF. stat4_total (evade/defender-DX) starts equal to the buffed dx_total (before the item loop). Loops the 8 inventory slots (slot_iter 0..7); for each whose flag byte inventory_slots[slot*2] has bit 0x40 (equipped) set, fetches the item-effect entry via fd2_get_item_effect_entry(inventory_slots[slot*2+1]) and adds the item's s16 boosts off the returned pointer: +1->AP, +3->DX(HT), +5->DP, +7->evade(EV). Then if status_flags_block[1] (ap_buff, 'strength' magic) set, ap_total = (int)(ap_total*1.15); if status_flags_block[2] (dp_buff, 'defense' magic) set, dp_total = (int)(dp_total*1.15). The double->int cast truncates toward zero (matches the binary's FPU RC=11 / FRNDINT + FISTP truncation semantic, not round-to-nearest). Finally writes the four totals back to rc[char_idx].ap (+0x48), .dp (+0x4A), .dx_current (+0x4C), .stat4_current (+0x4E). __CHK(0x24) frame check at entry; cyclomatic complexity 6.

params.name: char_idx
params.semantics: Index into the battle runtime char array (data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr); element stride is sizeof(runtime_char)=0x50. Identifies which active battle character's derived combat stats to recompute. Callers pass the affected character's battle index (e.g. selected actor, the char being equipped, the promotee, the XP recipient).
params.reason: Ghidra param is already named char_idx (ordinal 0, needs_rename=false) and the name accurately reflects usage (a runtime-char-array index). No address residue. No rename needed; src and Ghidra already agree.

returns.semantics: No return value. Side effect: writes the four recomputed 16-bit derived combat stats (AP/DP/DX_current/evade) into the battle runtime char at rc[char_idx] offsets +0x48/+0x4A/+0x4C/+0x4E.

It defers the shared per-slot algorithm to the twin's comment block (the established pattern). Nothing incorrect or misleading; left unchanged.
